$description: DMNC-1643: dos-86-light is amber-paper (the DOS light theme, Eggyolk) with the body face. Only the declarations that differ from amber-paper live here; everything else is amber-paper's rule, which lists dos-86-light in its selector (scripts/lib/theme-aliases.mjs, THEME_VARIANTS). Built into src/styles/theme.amber-paper.css as one extra rule.

primary.$description: Same declaration as theme.dos-86.tokens.json: the component text family points at the body face (JetBrains Mono Nerd Font), so toggling LIGHT on a dos-86 site does not change text width. Headings, display numbers and the brand keep the display face.
